name: Cherokee County, SC
findings: Cherokee County has 102 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cherokee County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 8 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.
